title: Expense Policy v3
text: Policy FIN-042, effective 2026-01-15. Meals are reimbursable up to $75 per person per day. Finance Operations owns this policy.

title: Expense Policy v2 (superseded)
text: Policy FIN-042, effective 2024-06-01. Meals are reimbursable up to $50 per person per day. This version was superseded on 2026-01-15.

title: Security Handbook
text: Report a suspected security incident in the #security-incidents Slack channel and page the on-call security engineer. Do not wait for manager approval.

title: Benefits Guide
text: Employees receive a $1,200 annual learning allowance. Eligible expenses include books, courses, and professional certifications.

title: Remote Work Policy
text: Employees may work outside their home province for up to 30 calendar days per year after written approval from People Operations.

title: Customer Support Escalation Runbook
text: Declare a SEV-1 when all customers cannot access search. Notify incident command within 10 minutes and post updates every 30 minutes.

title: ADR-017 Search Index
text: ADR-017 selects OpenSearch as the search index. PostgreSQL remains the source of truth for document and ingestion state.

title: Search migration discussion
text: A chat participant suggested making OpenSearch the system of record because it would simplify reads. No architecture decision adopted this suggestion.
